Name: Rescue: Captives at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Settlement Contract. Free the captives held at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> and protect them until help arrives. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: A crew at the <Alias=TargetLocation> is holding three people from a nearby settlement. Their families want them home.
I freed the first captive. Two more are held at the <Alias=TargetLocation>.
I freed the second captive. One more is held at the <Alias=TargetLocation>.
All three captives are free. I need to hold the ground round them until help arrives.
I freed three captives at the <Alias=TargetLocation> and held the ground round them until their people were nearly there.

Objectives.DisplayText: Free the first captive at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Free the second captive at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Free the last captive at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're not one of them. Untie me and I'll forgive you for taking so long.
Hold still, I'll cut you loose.
My hands. I'd stopped feeling them. Go and get the other two. I'm not going anywhere.
They said nobody would pay to have us back. Who's paying?
Your families are. Let's get these off you.
My wife and my daughter, then. They'll have sold something for this. I don't care what.
Is it over? Are they gone?
Not yet. Stay down, stay quiet.
I can do quiet. I've been doing quiet for three days.
They've got three of ours tied up at that site, and their families want them home. Cut them loose, then stay with them. That crew will be back for them, and we're not fast.
That's the last of them. Stay with them. Our people are nearly there.
